newsitem.title: UK: UK money market forecasts 800 mln stg shortage.
newsitem.headline: UK money market forecasts 800 mln stg shortage.

text.p: The average of forecasts by UK money market brokers of today's market shortage is 800 million stg, according to a Reuter market survey.

The official forecast for the shortage will be released by the Bank of England at between 0945 GMT and 1000 GMT. (If you want to be included in this survey, please phone Reuters London Newsroom on 0171 542 5109 or fax your estimate to 0171 542 6726.)
